name: pin
title: The pin: a snap pin through the frame's edge and a cartridge's wall, its head on the edge
orientation: Standing on its foot, as the generator draws it. Pushed from the frame's edge through its skin and the cartridge's wall: the barb clicks out inside the tray, the foot stays on the edge. A firm pull takes it out again. Print one per hole.

diameter.rule: The pin's diameter, the cartridges' and the frame's holes less a fit

length.rule: The shaft: through the frame's skin and a cartridge's wall, so the barb clicks out inside

slot.rule: The split down the pin from its tip: through the barb and most of the shaft

head.rule: The foot past the shaft all round: the head that shows on the frame's edge
